items.title: BMY Q3 deep dive: pipeline advances offset margin pressure as guidance shifts
items.summary: Biopharmaceutical company Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.9% year on year to $13.07 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $50 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.35 per share was 12.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: AbbVie vs. Bristol Myers Squibb: Which Healthcare Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: AbbVie boasts faster revenue growth and stronger cash generation, while Bristol Myers trades at half the valuation multiple, a classic growth-versus-value showdown.

items.title: 5 must-read analyst questions from Bristol-Myers Squibb’s Q3 earnings call
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb’s third quarter results reflected robust growth in its core portfolio, led by strong commercial execution and momentum across newer products. Management pointed to double-digit sales gains in key brands such as Reblozyl, Breyanzi, and Camzyos, as well as successful launches of new therapies like Symvexis.
